title: Nutty Shiro Stir Fry
description: A simple stir-fry recipe using nutty and shiro ingredients for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add bouncy and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add nutty and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add shiro and stir-fry until combined.
Add wot and stir-fry until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over injera or rice.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
